messages:
Riley Tran: Customer reported lower-than-expected March token usage. They say some calls returned 429 then 200 on retry; invoice missing those retries. Can eng confirm meter behavior?
Nina Shah: Which customer/org?
Riley Tran: org=zephyr-analytics. Sent sample req_ids showing suffixes like -retry2.
Omar Diaz: I pulled edge logs for 2026-03-30 16:02-16:12 UTC. We canonicalize req_ids by stripping trailing -retry*; that causes retries to be collapsed as duplicates and marked non-billable. Example: {"ts":"2026-03-30T16:03:01Z","req_id":"x123","status":429,"tokens":300} then {"ts":"2026-03-30T16:03:02Z","req_id":"x123-retry2","status":200,"tokens":300}.
Claire Huang: Estimated delta?
Omar Diaz: Quick aggregate from billing mirror: billed_if_counted=415000 tokens, currently billed=310000 tokens, delta=105000 tokens. At their tier that's $10.50.
Nina Shah: Small amount but customer wants correction and CSV. I approve one-off credit and backfill if eng provides dry-run CSV + checksum. :white_check_mark:
billing-bot: Precheck: backfill prerequisites: snapshot export, dry-run CSV, finance approval.
Omar Diaz: I'll run dry-run today, output CSV to /s3/fin/dryruns/1801209876.csv, include original and canonical req_ids. ETA 2 hours.
Riley Tran: Draft customer note: "We found an internal dedupe heuristic that collapsed retry attempts; we'll apply a one-time credit of $10.50 and run a metering backfill. Attached CSV and audit log." Approve?
Claire Huang: Approve wording. Please CC accounting and include audit log.
Nina Shah: After dry-run review, finance will sign off for commit. Also open an ops ticket to stop stripping retry suffixes or make retries billable when prior status=429.
Omar Diaz: Filed ENG-3129 for canonicalization fix. Will follow up with dry-run CSV and checksum.
Riley Tran: Thanks team.
